viv: Quick postmortem follow-up — the multi-hour pager waves on 2025-09-03. We sketched dedupe, threshold pruning, and a paging policy split. Need concrete owners, small experiments, and canary plan. Keep short updates here.
omar: I'll own dedupe/grouping. Plan: source-fingerprint (service+host+error_code) + 35s sliding window, but allow opt-out label for high-signal alerts. ETA 6 business days.
kelly: I'll do threshold pruning and retired-candidates list. Running p95/p99 baselines across 45d and will propose conservative bumps. ETA 3 days.
alerts-bot: Incident 2025-09-03: multi-wave-pager  401 pages in 5h. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/2025-09-03-wave (auto-attached).
yara: I'll draft the paging policy matrix (soft-page vs hard-page) and a 3-step canary: 3 services -> 20% -> full. Will include rollback criteria and success metrics. ETA 7 days.
viv: Good. Please add owner+ETA+risk to the tracker: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-triage. We'll create JIRA tickets from there.
omar: local dedupe snippet I'm testing in staging:
```yaml
alert: downstream-errors
expr: sum by(service, host, error_code) (rate(errors_total[1m]))
for: 2m
dedupe_key: "{{service}}:{{host}}:{{error_code}}"
dedupe_window: 35s
labels:
  allow_high_signal: "false"
```
kelly: My query to find noisy alerts:
```sql
SELECT alert_name, count(*) as fires, percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (value) as p95
FROM alert_fires
WHERE ts > now() - interval '45 days'
GROUP BY alert_name
HAVING count(*) > 15
ORDER BY fires DESC;
```
yara: For paging matrix: soft-page -> #alerts for non-SLA and informational; hard-page -> on-call for Sev0/1 and SLA-impact. Auto-escalate after 12m. Canary success: <=10% change in total pages, no missed SLA pages.
viv: Nice. Make sure PRs link back to action tracker and include test plan and rollback steps.
omar: Putting PR up to add dedupe templates to staging tomorrow, will ping.
kelly: I'll attach baseline graphs and a short retire list to the tracker after the job finishes tonight.
alerts-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync 2025-09-06 09:00 PST. Agenda item added: pager triage checkin.
yara: I'll draft the policy doc and share a 1-page summary for review before the sync.
viv: Thanks team. Let's keep this thread as the single source for updates and close actions in the sync. If anything looks off during canary, post here and we'll rollback immediately. :thumbsup:
